tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The display. One continuous black field behind every module; never put a card background on it.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Overlays only: settings sheet, detail views, tray menu. Always paired with a rule-strong border.

tokens.name: bg-invert
tokens.usage: Fill of the selected option in a segmented control (text becomes bg). The only inverted surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg: clock dots, date, AI rows, world clock rows. 18.2:1 on bg.

tokens.name: ink-1
tokens.usage: Values inside the subdued left panel (CPU %, RAM GB). 12.2:1 on bg.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: table headers, labels, metric names. 6.6:1 on bg.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: status bar, section headings, shortcut hints. 4.75:1 on bg (4.6:1 on bg-raised), the floor for any text.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and panels. Decorative, never the only cue.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Overlay borders, control outlines, window frame. 3.1:1 on bg, 3.0:1 on bg-raised.

tokens.name: meter-off
tokens.usage: Unlit dots in meters and dot plots (the dotted underline in the reference).

tokens.name: matrix-ghost
tokens.usage: Unlit dots of the dot-matrix clock when Ghost Dots is on. Barely visible by design.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Warnings only: usage at or above the warn threshold, error rows, sensor faults. Never decorative. 9.1:1 on bg.

tokens.name: amber-dim
tokens.usage: Unlit dots of a meter that is in warning state.

tokens.name: desk
tokens.usage: Mockup only: Windows desktop behind windowed/compact/tray scenes.

tokens.name: taskbar
tokens.usage: Mockup only: Windows taskbar strip.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", "IBM Plex Mono", "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace

styles.name: t-board
styles.usage: AI usage rows and world clock rows. Uppercase, tabular numerals.

styles.name: t-metric
styles.usage: Rows in the subdued left panel.

styles.name: t-countdown
styles.usage: Pomodoro remaining time when idle (active state uses the dot matrix).

styles.name: t-status
styles.usage: Status bar indicators and window controls.

styles.name: t-control
styles.usage: Settings rows, segmented controls, menu items.

styles.name: t-micro
styles.usage: Hints and meta lines. Never smaller than 12px at 1080p.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Dot gap inside meters; icon-to-text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Control padding; status indicator gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a value and its meter.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Settings row padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between metric columns.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks inside a column.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Gap between the clock block, AI block and world clock.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Gutter between left panel and main display; outer page padding at 1080p.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything by default: panels, controls, overlays.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Tray menu and focus rings only.

tokens.name: radius-win
tokens.usage: Outer window corner in windowed mode (matches Windows 11).

matrix.note: Dot-matrix geometry. One glyph is 5 x 7 dots; one empty column between glyphs; colon is one column.

tokens.name: matrix-pitch-xl
tokens.usage: Main clock at 1920x1080 (glyph 196px tall).

tokens.name: matrix-pitch-l
tokens.usage: Focus countdown in Pomodoro-active state; compact clock.

tokens.name: matrix-pitch-m
tokens.usage: Mini widget clock and settings preview.

tokens.name: matrix-dot
tokens.usage: Dot diameter as a share of pitch.
